items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 29, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I mean I don’t mind the reference to something that happened in a different time... Wallis Simpson was the woman who the Prince of England fell in love with and gave up his throne for.

ctx.x: I think that there are some songs that I feel like naa, this is too dated, as far as maybe a lyrical reference to some things.
That’s just what I was thinking about. Like that song, “I Can’t Get Started,” he’s talking about the Prince of Wales and starting a revolution in Spain.

Right. I mean I think those are great lyrics. I don’t know if everybody will get it or if they will go oh this is dated. I mean I don’t mind dated. I don’t mind the reference to something that happened in a different time. Lenny Bruce did a thing one time where he said, “I feel just like Walli Simpson.” And I’m like, Walli Simpson? Who’s Walli Simpson? Wallis Simpson was the woman who the Prince of England fell in love with and gave up his throne for. Well I didn’t get it until I started to figure it — I…
